This objective of the Challenge is to promote robust modeling strategies that capture the complex factors influencing user engagement. Participants explored a variety of multi-mo…

results.snippet: Foundation model developers are among the world's most important companies. As these companies become increasingly consequential, how do their transparency practices evolve? The 2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index is the third edition of an annual effort to characterize and quantify the transparency of foundation model developers. The 2025 FMTI introduces new indicators related to data acquisition, usage data, and monitoring and evaluates companies like Alibaba, DeepSeek, and xAI for the first time. The 2024 FMTI reported that transparency was improving, but the 2025 FMTI finds this prog…

results.title: Inference-Time Attention Steering for Vision-Language-Action Driving Models
results.snippet: Vision-language-action (VLA) driving models couple a reasoning stage with a diffusion-based trajectory decoder, but do not give a direct way to redirect attention toward safety-critical actors at inference time without retraining. We studied a bounded additive pre-softmax attention bias on the visual tokens of detector localized traffic actors on Alpamayo-R1's Qwen3-VL backbone. It is applied as a fail open forward pre-hook with no weight changes. On 50 lane-change scenarios from the Physical AI World Model Synthetic dataset. The trajectory decoder shows a monotonic dose response in the bias…

results.title: ForeTime-VLA: Causal Future-Token Distillation from a World Action Model for Conveyor-Belt Manipulation
results.snippet: Manipulating moving objects requires a policy to anticipate contact events, yet vision-language-action (VLA) policies are commonly fine-tuned from the current observation alone. World action models (WAMs) learn predictive dynamics, but running a video-scale teacher or explicitly imagining future frames at deployment is costly. We introduce ForeTime-VLA, a dense pi0.5 policy that distills a future-aware, action-equivalent representation from a frozen Fast-WAM-derived teacher while remaining causal at inference. Offline, current and future video latents are compressed into a whitened 64-D targe…

findings.point: ForeTime-VLA 通过从世界动作模型 (WAM) 蒸馏因果未来 token，将预测动态压缩进稠密 pi0.5 策略，实现传送带操作中对接触事件的预判，且部署时无需运行视频级教师模型。
findings.evidence: 论文指出 VLA 策略通常仅基于当前观测微调，而 WAM 学习预测动态但部署代价高；ForeTime-VLA 通过未来 token 蒸馏解决此矛盾，在传送带操作任务上验证。
findings.attention: 高 —— 直接结合世界模型与 VLA 解决动态操作预判问题，属于核心前沿方向
findings.recommendation: ★★★★★ —— 为世界模型在机器人操作中的高效部署提供关键范式，相关性极强

findings.evidence: 在 Alpamayo-R1 的 Qwen3-VL 主干上，对检测器定位的交通参与者视觉 token 施加有界加性 pre-softmax 注意力偏置，实现推理时的安全导向注意力重分配。

results.title: GEM-4D: Geometry-Enhanced Video World Models for Robot Manipulation
results.snippet: Video world models can generate realistic futures from a single instruction, but they often fail to track the same physical points consistently across time. As a result, the generated videos appear plausible, yet lack the physical grounding required for reliable action execution, such as robot manipulation. We present GEM-4D, a geometry-grounded video world model that resolves this limitation by injecting dense 4D correspondence supervision distilled from a pretrained geometry foundation model into the video generative backbone during training. ### 1.3 方法演进脉络（基于现有证据重构）

1. **模块化感知-规划-控制**（~2020） →  
2. **端到端行为克隆 / 模仿学习**（ACT, Diffusion Policy, BC-Z，2022-2023） →  
3. **大规模跨本体预训练 + 语言条件**（RT-1, Open X-Embodiment, RT-2，2022-2023） →  
4. **视觉语言动作基础模型**（VLA：RT-2, Octo, OpenVLA，2023-2024） →  
5. **世界模型辅助预测与规划**（GEM-4D, What-If World, ForeTime-VLA，2025-2026） →  
6. **推理时干预与蒸馏部署**（Attention Steering, ForeTime-VLA 蒸馏，2026）  

> **不确定**：步骤 4-6 的主流采纳度与真机 SOTA 仍依赖于 **独立复现与基准榜单验证**，当前多为预印本宣称。[7][8][10][11][12][20]

## 4. 瓶颈与拐点

| 瓶颈维度 | 现状与证据 | 拐点信号 | 置信度 | 引用 |
|----------|------------|----------|--------|------|
| **数据规模与质量** | Open X-Embodiment 等数据集推动预训练，但真机高质量轨迹仍稀缺；AgiBot World Colosseo [6] 尝试大规模平台 | **大规模真机数据采集平台标准化 + 自动化标注管线** 出现 | 中 | [6] |
| **世界模型训练目标与下游任务错位** | 视频生成损失 ≠ 任务成功率；GEM-4D [20] 引入几何先验、What-If World [12] 引入因果基准，尝试缩小鸿沟 | **任务感知的世界模型目标（如价值感知预测、策略引导预测）** 成为主流 | 中 | [12][20] |
| **推理算力与实时性** | VLA 模型参数量大（>1B），端侧部署需量化/蒸馏/剪枝；ForeTime-VLA [8] 通过蒸馏压缩至 π0.5 | **专用推理加速器（NPU/TPU）+ 模型压缩协同设计** 使 7B 级 VLA 达到 >30Hz 真机控制 | 中高 | [8] |
| **Sim-to-Real 评测缺失** | 当前基准多为仿真内榜单，缺乏系统性真机对齐度量 [26] | **RSS/CoRL 设立 Sim-to-Real 专项基准赛道**，要求提交真机复现报告 | 高 | [26] |
| **安全与可解释性** | 端到端 VLA 为黑箱；Attention Steering [7] 为推理时干预探索 | **形式化验证 + 推理时护栏 + 世界模型反事实推理** 组合成标准安全栈 | 中 | [7][12] |

> **拐点预测**：若 **2026 年底前** 出现 **“在 ≥3 种本体、≥10 个长时程任务上，真机成功率 >90% 且单模型部署”** 的开源系统，将标志着 **世界模型赋能 VLA 进入工程化拐点**；反之仍处学术探索期。[P]
